newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria c.bank confirms rate rise to 5.50 pct/yr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria c.bank confirms rate rise to 5.50 pct/yr.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) confirmed on Thursday it will raise its main lev interest rate to 5.50 percent from 5.42 percent, effective Monday.
The rate rise was reported earlier on Thursday by commercial bank dealers.
"The BNB board decided to set the main interest rate (simple annual interest rate) at 5.50 percent, with effect from August 4, 1997," a BNB statement said.
The new higher main rate was calculated on the basis of the average yield to maturity on three-month discount T-bills sold by the Finance Ministry on Monday, the BNB said.
The average yield to maturity on the paper was 1.38 percent, up from 1.36 percent at the previous auction on July 21, Finance Ministry figures showed. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 981 4145
